sources.title: UniFi Pro Max 16 PoE - Tech Specs
sources.evidence_note: Official twelve 1 GbE PoE+ ports, four 2.5 GbE PoE++ ports, two 10G SFP+ ports and 180 W PoE availability.

notes: The source lists an external 210 W AC/DC power supply and does not establish storage or physical fan capability.
